Package model

Enum Class TileType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TileType>
model.TileType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<TileType>, Constable
public enum TileType extends Enum<TileType>
Defines all tile categories used for constructing static level geometry. Each TileType is mapped to: - a character symbol used in the text-based map file - a texture path used for rendering - a physical height (affects hitbox size) TileType is used by TileManager to convert map characters into actual TileBlock objects placed into the world.
